newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end lower as mood turned negative.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end lower as mood turned negative.

text.p: Madrid stocks lost initial gains Thursday afternoon with both indices ending down more than one percent while dealers said the general mood has turned negative.

"The Spanish stock market is overvalued for fundamental reasons..so there are people looking for alternative markets, like the Italian one..but the buying from domestic investment trusts is offering very good support," a Madrid-based dealer said.
The general index lost 7.20 points, or 1.15 percent to 618.32, while Ibex-35 shed 101 points, or 1.42 percent to 7.034.78.
